title: Looking for a Unicorn
moral: If you are kind to someone, you can meet a unicorn of your very own.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 영어 녹음도 같은 문장 경계에서 자른다(trim_read.py unicorn en), new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<uc_bg2_hill|uc_bg2_cloudland|uc_bg2: 장면 배경(scene(key)). scenes[].set 으로 자동 호출
acts.kid:look:<stand|walk|sad|tired|turn|hug|: 다현이(uc_kid2_*). y 는 항상 바닥 FL. front = 월드 맨 앞으로
acts.uni:look:<stand|back|hide_cloud|peek_clo: 유니콘. 1~9장은 장소별 숨는 자세, 앞 가림 조각(fg)이 z 순서로 덮는다
acts.sheep:look:<cry|jump|happy>[:<dir>] | sh: 양. jump = 구름에서 포물선으로 뛰어내림, behind:home = 집 뒤로(z)
acts.cloud:at | bush:at | rainbow:at | basket: 소품·중간 소품(mid)·앞 가림 조각(fg). thorns:pull = 가시 셋이 차례로 쏙 빠짐(pop 효과음, 숫자 목소리 없음)

lines.text: 언덕 위에 다현이가 서 있어요. 하늘을 올려다보고 있어요.
lines.en: On a hill stands Dahyun, looking up at the sky.
segs: On a hill stands Dahyun, looking up at the sky.

lines.text: 파란 하늘에 하얀 구름이 두둥실 떠가고, 풀잎은 살랑살랑 흔들렸어요.
lines.en: White clouds drifted, drifted across the blue sky, and the grass swayed softly, swish, swish.
segs: White clouds drifted, drifted across the blue sky, and the grass swayed softly, swish, swish.

lines.text: 다현이가 혼잣말을 했어요.
lines.en: Dahyun said to herself.

lines.text: 진짜 유니콘을 만나고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to meet a real unicorn.
segs: I want to meet a real unicorn.

lines.text: 다현이는 바람에 떨어진 꽃 한 송이를 살며시 주워 바구니에 쏙 넣었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun gently picked up a flower the wind had dropped and popped it into her basket.
segs: Dahyun gently picked up a flower the wind had dropped and popped it into her basket.

lines.text: 다현이는 구름 나라로 올라가 보기로 했어요.
lines.en: Dahyun decided to climb up to the cloud country.
segs: Dahyun decided to climb up to the cloud country.

lines.text: 다현이는 간식 바구니를 들고 사뿐사뿐 언덕을 올라갔어요.
lines.en: Dahyun picked up her snack basket and tiptoed lightly, step, step, up the hill.
segs: Dahyun picked up her snack basket and tiptoed lightly, step, step, up the hill.

lines.text: 언덕을 오른 다현이가 구름 나라에 다다랐어요.
lines.en: Dahyun climbed the hill and reached cloudland.
segs: Dahyun climbed the hill and reached cloudland.

lines.text: 구름 섬에 양 한 마리가 혼자 앉아 있어요.
lines.en: On a cloud island, a little sheep sat all alone.
segs: On a cloud island, a little sheep sat all alone.

lines.text: 양은 길을 잃어 훌쩍훌쩍 울고 있었어요.
lines.en: The sheep was lost and crying. Sniff, sniff.
segs: The sheep was lost and crying. Sniff, sniff.

lines.text: 훌쩍… 집에 어떻게 가지…
lines.en: Sniff... How do I get home...
segs: Sniff... How do I get home...

lines.text: 다현이가 양 아래에서 두 팔을 벌렸어요.
lines.en: Dahyun opened her arms below the sheep.
segs: Dahyun opened her arms below the sheep.

lines.text: 괜찮아, 내가 받아 줄게!
lines.en: It's okay, I'll catch you!

lines.text: 양이 폴짝 뛰어내렸어요!
lines.en: The sheep hopped right down!

lines.text: 양은 폭신폭신 구름을 미끄러져 다현이 품에 폭, 안겼어요.
lines.en: The sheep slid down the soft, fluffy cloud and landed, plop, right in Dahyun's arms.
segs: The sheep slid down the soft, fluffy cloud and landed, plop, right in Dahyun's arms.

lines.text: 같이 가자!
lines.en: Let's go together!

lines.text: 다현이와 양은 손을 잡고 구름 길을 걸었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun and the sheep walked the cloud path hand in hand.
segs: Dahyun and the sheep walked the cloud path hand in hand.

lines.text: 구름 길은 폭신폭신, 걸을 때마다 발밑이 통통 튀었어요.
lines.en: The cloud path was soft and fluffy, and it bounced, boing, boing, under their feet with every step.
segs: The cloud path was soft and fluffy, and it bounced, boing, boing, under their feet with every step.

lines.text: 저 멀리 작은 지붕이 보였어요. 양이 귀를 쫑긋 세웠지요.
lines.en: Far away, a little roof came into view. The sheep's ears perked right up.
segs: Far away, a little roof came into view. The sheep's ears perked right up.

lines.text: 고마워! 이제 집이 보여!
lines.en: Thank you! I can see my home now!
segs: Thank you! I can see my home now!

lines.text: 양은 집으로 돌아갔어요. 유니콘은 아직 보이지 않아요.
lines.en: The sheep went home. The unicorn was still nowhere to be seen.
segs: The sheep went home. The unicorn was still nowhere to be seen.

lines.text: 밤이 되자, 다현이는 별빛 숲으로 들어갔어요.
lines.en: When night came, Dahyun walked into the starlight forest.
segs: When night came, Dahyun walked into the starlight forest.

lines.text: 별빛이 반짝반짝, 나뭇잎 사이로 쏟아져 내렸어요.
lines.en: Starlight came twinkling, twinkle, twinkle, down through the leaves.
segs: Starlight came twinkling, twinkle, twinkle, down through the leaves.

lines.text: 다현이는 숲속에서 아픈 사슴을 만났어요.
lines.en: In the forest, Dahyun met a deer who was hurt.
segs: In the forest, Dahyun met a deer who was hurt.

lines.text: 아야, 아야…
lines.en: Ouch, ouch...

lines.text: 사슴 다리에 가시가 박혔어요.
lines.from: 사슴 다리에 가시가 박혔어요. 가시를 톡, 눌러 봐요. 살살 빼 줄게요.
lines.en: There are thorns in the deer's leg.
segs: There are thorns in the deer's leg.

lines.text: 다현이는 살살, 조심조심 가시를 하나씩 뽑았어요. 쏙, 쏙, 쏙!
lines.en: Gently, ever so carefully, Dahyun pulled out the thorns one by one. Pop, pop, pop!
segs: Gently, ever so carefully, Dahyun pulled out the thorns one by one. Pop, pop, pop!

lines.text: 가시 세 개를 모두 뺐어요!
lines.en: All three thorns are out!

lines.text: 고마워! 이제 하나도 안 아파.
lines.en: Thank you! It doesn't hurt at all now.
segs: Thank you! It doesn't hurt at all now.

lines.text: 가시를 뺀 뒤에도 다현이는 숲에서 사슴 곁에 있었어요.
lines.en: After pulling out the thorns, Dahyun stayed beside the deer in the forest.
segs: After pulling out the thorns, Dahyun stayed beside the deer in the forest.

lines.text: 다현이는 사슴의 작은 뿔을 가만히 보았어요.
lines.en: Dahyun looked quietly at the deer's little antlers.
segs: Dahyun looked quietly at the deer's little antlers.

lines.text: 유니콘은… 아니구나.
lines.en: You're... not a unicorn.

lines.text: 사슴은 고개를 끄덕끄덕 인사하고, 사뿐사뿐 숲속으로 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: The deer nodded, nod, nod, to say goodbye, and stepped softly, step, step, back into the forest.
segs: The deer nodded, nod, nod, to say goodbye, and stepped softly, step, step, back into the forest.

lines.text: 쏴아아, 커다란 폭포 소리가 들려왔어요.
lines.en: Whoosh, splash! Dahyun heard the sound of a great big waterfall.
segs: Whoosh, splash! Dahyun heard the sound of a great big waterfall.

lines.text: 숲을 떠난 다현이는 폭포 앞에 다다랐어요.
lines.en: Dahyun left the forest and reached the waterfall.
segs: Dahyun left the forest and reached the waterfall.

lines.text: 폭포 위에 무지개가 떠 있어요. 말 한 마리가 서 있어요.
lines.en: A rainbow hangs over the waterfall. A horse is standing there.
segs: A rainbow hangs over the waterfall. A horse is standing there.

lines.text: 물방울이 반짝반짝 튀고, 무지개는 알록달록 빛났지요.
lines.en: Water drops sparkled, sparkle, sparkle, and the rainbow glowed in every colour.
segs: Water drops sparkled, sparkle, sparkle, and the rainbow glowed in every colour.

lines.text: 말의 배에서 소리가 났어요.
lines.en: A sound came from the horse’s tummy.
segs: A sound came from the horse’s tummy.

lines.text: 꼬르륵…
lines.en: Grrrumble...

lines.text: 말은 다현이의 간식 바구니를 보고 있어요.
lines.en: The horse was looking at Dahyun's snack basket.
segs: The horse was looking at Dahyun's snack basket.

lines.text: 폭포 앞에서 다현이가 배고픈 말에게 말했어요.
lines.en: By the waterfall, Dahyun spoke to the hungry horse.
segs: By the waterfall, Dahyun spoke to the hungry horse.

lines.text: 자, 같이 먹자.
lines.en: Here, let's share.

lines.text: 다현이는 바구니를 열어 간식을 반으로 똑 나누었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun opened the basket and broke the snack, snap, right in half.
segs: Dahyun opened the basket and broke the snack, snap, right in half.

lines.text: 말은 간식을 냠냠 맛있게 먹었어요.
lines.en: The horse munched the snack happily.
segs: The horse munched the snack happily.

lines.text: 고마워! 정말 맛있었어.
lines.en: Thank you! That was delicious.

lines.text: 너도… 유니콘은 아니구나.
lines.en: You're not... a unicorn either.

lines.text: 말은 히힝 인사하고, 다그닥다그닥 무지개 너머로 달려갔어요.
lines.en: The horse neighed goodbye, neigh, and galloped away, clip-clop, clip-clop, over the rainbow.
segs: The horse neighed goodbye, neigh, and galloped away, clip-clop, clip-clop, over the rainbow.

lines.text: 말과 헤어진 다현이가 혼자 길로 나왔어요.
lines.en: After saying goodbye to the horse, Dahyun came out onto the road alone.
segs: After saying goodbye to the horse, Dahyun came out onto the road alone.

lines.text: 해가 지고, 길은 텅 비었어요.
lines.en: The sun went down, and the road was empty.
segs: The sun went down, and the road was empty.

lines.text: 바람만 휘이잉, 마른 나뭇가지를 흔들고 지나갔어요.
lines.en: Only the wind blew past, whoosh, shaking the bare branches.
segs: Only the wind blew past, whoosh, shaking the bare branches.

lines.text: 진짜 유니콘은… 없나 봐.
lines.en: Maybe... there is no real unicorn.
segs: Maybe... there is no real unicorn.

lines.text: 다현이는 땅만 보며 터벅터벅 걸었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun trudged along, looking only at the ground.
segs: Dahyun trudged along, looking only at the ground.

lines.text: 다리는 무겁고, 눈은 자꾸 깜빡깜빡 감겼어요.
lines.en: Her legs felt heavy, and her eyes kept drooping, blink, blink.
segs: Her legs felt heavy, and her eyes kept drooping, blink, blink.

lines.text: 둥근 달이 두둥실 떠올라 길을 환하게 비추었어요.
lines.en: A round moon floated up, up into the sky and lit the road bright.
segs: A round moon floated up, up into the sky and lit the road bright.

lines.text: 다현이는 그 길을 계속 걷고 있었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun was still walking along the road.
segs: Dahyun was still walking along the road.

lines.text: 그때, 뒤에서 작은 소리가 났어요.
lines.en: Just then, a small sound came from behind.
segs: Just then, a small sound came from behind.

lines.text: 사박, 사박. 조용한 발소리가 점점 가까워졌어요.
lines.en: Pit-pat, pit-pat. Quiet footsteps came closer and closer.
segs: Pit-pat, pit-pat. Quiet footsteps came closer and closer.

lines.text: 다현이 뒤에 누가 왔을까요?
lines.en: Who came up behind Dahyun?

lines.text: 달빛 아래, 하얀 유니콘이 서 있었어요.
lines.en: There in the moonlight stood a white unicorn.
segs: There in the moonlight stood a white unicorn.

lines.text: 유니콘이 다현이에게 다정하게 말했어요.
lines.en: The unicorn spoke gently to Dahyun.
segs: The unicorn spoke gently to Dahyun.

lines.text: 나는 계속 여기 있었어.
lines.en: I was here all along.

lines.text: 네가 친절한 걸 다 보고 있었어.
lines.en: I saw how kind you were, every time.
segs: I saw how kind you were, every time.

lines.text: 양에게도, 사슴에게도, 말에게도 말이야.
lines.en: To the sheep, to the deer, and to the horse, too.
segs: To the sheep, to the deer, and to the horse, too.

lines.text: 유니콘…!
lines.en: A unicorn...!

lines.text: 다현이의 눈이 반짝반짝 빛났어요. 가슴이 콩닥콩닥 뛰었지요.
lines.en: Dahyun's eyes shone, sparkle, sparkle. Her heart went thump, thump, thump.
segs: Dahyun's eyes shone, sparkle, sparkle. Her heart went thump, thump, thump.

lines.text: 다현이는 유니콘을 꼭 안았어요.
lines.en: Dahyun hugged the unicorn tight.

lines.text: 다음 날 아침, 다현이는 유니콘과 함께 집 앞 언덕으로 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: The next morning, Dahyun came back to the hill by her home with the unicorn.
segs: The next morning, Dahyun came back to the hill by her home with the unicorn.

lines.text: 다현이는 바구니 속 빨간 꽃을 유니콘 갈기에 살며시 꽂아 주었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun gently tucked the red flower from her basket into the unicorn's mane.
segs: Dahyun gently tucked the red flower from her basket into the unicorn's mane.

lines.text: 유니콘이 다현이에게 고맙다고 말했어요.
lines.en: The unicorn thanked Dahyun.

lines.text: 고마워, 정말 예뻐!
lines.en: Thank you. It's so pretty!

lines.text: 너도 누군가에게 친절하면, 너만의 유니콘을 만날 수 있답니다.
lines.en: If you are kind to someone, you can meet a unicorn of your very own.
segs: If you are kind to someone, you can meet a unicorn of your very own.
